changes: Costs the Octatrack nothing of its own while no slot of the project uses Euclid (base 0.8): on an MKII it added 1.5 points of frame time at rest before, none now.
Uses a little less DSP time with exactly the same sound: its filter loop waits less on the DSP between instructions.
Picking Euclid wakes it before the pick lands; controls, defaults and saved projects are unchanged.
Known issue: checked on an MKII by an automated run only; not yet tested by ear or on the MKI.
Fixes the dry signal staying mixed in after TYPE passed AMP: turning TYPE to NOTCH and back left part of the unfiltered sound playing alongside LP, BP, HP or NOTCH (#1690).
Fixes a rare case where starting playback could interrupt Euclid’s timing reset halfway. Timing, swing and controls are unchanged.
Media only: adds an audio preview of Euclid at 128 BPM.
Available over USB on the Modwerk beta base; the module itself is unchanged.
Fixes the beta base showing DSP MEMORY FULL when picking Euclid although there was room for it.
Documentation only: explains that MIX 127 is fully wet and why it can sound dry with the filter open or DEPTH at center (#681).
Documentation only: explains how Euclid follows the track’s SWING settings and adds a picture of the settings page.
Documentation only: adds screenshots of the selection and control pages and explains how to open them.
Documentation only: updates the author credits.
First Modwerk catalog release of the stereo Euclidean modulation effect, following the instrument’s transport, tempo, track speed and swing.
